Method of Attack: Trojanized Chrome extension stealing Facebook session cookies
Malicious code uses OnInstalled handler to steal Facebook cookies
Exfiltrates encrypted Facebook cookies via GET request
Hijacks Facebook sessions for malvertising and propaganda
Changes login details and profile to prevent account recovery
Attack Vector: Fake landing page leading to malicious extension
Indicators of Compromise: Extension uploaded to Chrome Web Store on February 14, 2023
Promoted via Google Search ads starting March 14, 2023
Encrypted cookies attached to X-Cached-Key HTTP header
Fake persona named 'Lilly Collins' used on hijacked Facebook profiles
